name: Controversy
overview: Scripture reveals that controversy often arises from the deceitful and wicked nature of the human heart, making it difficult to discern true motives or outcomes. Believers are instructed to avoid engaging in foolish disputes and contentious arguments, especially those that are unprofitable and vain. Ultimately, the promise of God’s future reign includes the removal of all pain, sorrow, and strife, pointing to a time when controversy and conflict will cease entirely.
